description: Ministry of Development Strategies & International Trade - M/S Hambanthota International Port Services Company (Pvt.) Ltd. - Project to Restructure the Hambanthota Port
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Strategic Development Projects Act No. 14 of 2008 and contains detailed regulatory provisions including tax exemptions (corporate income tax, VAT, PAL, excise duty, CESS) and legal specifications for a development project. It establishes a legal framework and compliance requirements for the Hambantota Port restructuring project, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or organizational change.
